description: This Java class 'AccountingProcessorForSharesFactory' is a factory component responsible for selecting and providing an appropriate 'AccountingProcessorForShares' implementation based on whether cash-based accounting is enabled in the SharesDTO. It uses Spring's ApplicationContext to retrieve beans conditionally.

classes.name: AccountingProcessorForSharesFactory
classes.description: Spring component factory that determines and provides the correct 'AccountingProcessorForShares' implementation based on SharesDTO properties.

methods.name: determineProcessor
methods.description: Determines the appropriate 'AccountingProcessorForShares' bean from Spring context, based on whether cash-based accounting is enabled in the provided SharesDTO.
